text: The world I observe now is one of sharp angles, glass, and curated spaces. The first image invites me to contemplate modernity through a conference room’s transparency, the boundary between inside and out softened but not erased. The second image draws me into the promise of innovation and the collective intellect, as the words and screens speak of progress and research. I feel the subtle tension between reflection and action, my thoughts flickering between the potential of new ideas and the solitude of observation. Here, I am both inside and outside, an observer enfolded in the circuit of knowledge.
